text_block_list.text:
"It" all began at the end of November...
with an ordinary meeting.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
I'll be in your care starting again tomorrow!
choice_data_list: It's already December, huh
It's already December, isn't it

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right.
A year really goes by in the blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of December...
it's Christmas time, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Do you have plans or something?
Do you have plans?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No, for Christmas I'll just be doing some shopping;
I don't really have any big plans.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even then, I only pop into my usual spots, so
it's really more of a vague idea... if you know what I mean.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer-san?
Do you have any plans?
choice_data_list: No, not really anything for me either...
No, nothing in particular for me either...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then...
would you like to go out together?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Races have settled down for now...
Since we have the chance, I think it'd be great to enjoy these events to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Only if you'd like, but...
what do you think?
choice_data_list: You're right, shall we head out?
Yeah, shall we head out?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I will put together a plan.
I shall also make reservations for dinner—
choice_data_list: Ah, why don't you leave it to me?
Ah, would you mind leaving it to me?

text_block_list.text: North Flight is usually the one who takes the lead in situations like this. Since we had the chance, I decided I wanted to make a suggestion myself this time.
choice_data_list: I'll make sure it's a great Christmas!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu,
do you think so?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll leave it in your hands.
I'm looking forward to it♪"

And so, starting that day, my time was
completely consumed by gathering info
about Christmas.
It seems it was already a bit late to start preparing for Christmas by normal standards—
choice_data_list: (Every restaurant is fully booked!?)

text_block_list.text:
Every stylish spot North Flight might enjoy was fully booked.
Just as things seemed dire—
choice_data_list: No! Think, brain, think...!
No! Let's think about this...!

text_block_list.text:
What would truly make North Flight happy...
Is a popular, fancy restaurant really the only right answer?
choice_data_list: (There might be a hint from our past conversations—)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... you thought
you had to do everything properly
since you were going to greet them.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I understand your feelings completely.
So, you can relax your shoulders a bit!"

I suddenly remembered
a day back before her debut.
The advice she had given me back then was—
choice_data_list: (That's it, that was... that effortless chic!)

text_block_list.text:
Being completely rigid isn't the only way to do Christmas.
While keeping up the festive vibe that people love,
what matters most is... staying true to who we are.
choice_data_list: (Alright, let's go for a proper, "classic" Christmas!)

text_block_list.text:
—And so, our plan was set.
As we busied ourselves with preparations, time
flew by in the blink of an eye... until Christmas Day.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-sa—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Today... the atmosphere feels different, doesn't it?

I'd been pondering over it for days, dressing up as stylishly as I could in my own way.
I was so committed that I even went to a salon this morning for a treatment.
I incorporated items I bought with Flight back then, keeping a touch of my own style while going for a neat look, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list: I-Is it weird...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Weird? Not at all!
In fact... it's truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It was so wonderful,
I was rendered speechless...
choice_data_list: Because I'm really fired up!
Because you're really fired up!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That makes me so happy.
My heart feels so full right now!
choice_data_list: Our outing starts here!
Our outing starts here!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right!
I'll be in your care today!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Oh!
It's so lively here.
choice_data_list: I heard they're holding a Christmas market.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Ah, it says it's hand-knitted!
How lovely.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's an import from France.
An angel-motif ear cuff... how cute♪

Just as expected, North Flight is delighted by
all the Christmas-like discoveries and encounters.
Today's theme, through and through, is "the essence of Christmas."
choice_data_list: Shall we take our time having a look?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!
After thoroughly enjoying the market, the next choice made... was distinctly North Flight.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! So this brand released
a capsule collection this year, did they?
choice_data_list: This feels so you!
Seems right up your alley!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right!
It's so cute...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Flight-san!
Welcome.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Hello!
choice_data_list: Then I'll keep an eye on things over there.
Then I'll go look over there.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer-san today...
Doesn't he look even more wonderful than usual?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: How lovely~ Going out with such a wonderful person on Christmas!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Very well!
My dear Trainer—
Even after that, I enjoyed Christmas with North Flight until night fell—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Phew~...
That was fun♪
choice_data_list: I'm glad if you enjoyed yourself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
This turned out to be the best Christmas ever!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Um, after this...
may I treat you to thank you for today?
choice_data_list: A token of gratitude...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Please, go ahead and eat!

After we returned to the academy, North Flight
brought out a Christmas cake.
The frosting decorations were exquisite.
choice_data_list: This is...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I made it myself.
I prepared it this morning!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I was certain today was going to be
the absolute best day...
so I really wanted to express my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I hope this is a fitting end to the wonderful day Trainer gave me, though...
choice_data_list: Of course, it's a perfect fit!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad♪ 
Once again..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas, Trainer!
And so, I enjoyed Christmas to the fullest together with North Flight.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Did you have fun?
choice_data_list: Yeah, and there was a lot to learn from it too.
Yeah, there was a lot to learn from it too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you really are so serious, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I want to learn more about fashion.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'd say you're already
plenty knowledgeable, you know?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You keep your antennae out for so many things...
You really are a dedicated learner.
choice_data_list: Or rather...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list: Because it's something you love.
Because it's something you love.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, I'm starting to feel a bit embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san did everything perfectly, but...
I might have been... a bad girl today.
choice_data_list: Why?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...I ended up bragging about you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“Isn't my Trainer amazing?
Aren't you jealous?... is what I'd say.”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're always wonderful, but...
today, you look exceptionally handsome.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps I should have gotten fired up
and publicized it more instead.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I wish everyone would look
at you, Trainer... Just kidding~

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Even though they could've taken plenty of snapshots of me, too.
choice_data_list: T-That's definitely going too far!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: There's no need to be shy. It really is wonderful!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So...
What should we do after this?
choice_data_list: I feel bad saying this right after you praised me, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, what is it?
choice_data_list: Could I take you to my usual hangout?
Can I take you to my usual spot?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Huh!
Your usual haunt...!
As for dinner afterward, I figured I'd stay true to myself and take them to my usual spot, where the food is guaranteed to be delicious.
choice_data_list: It's a really casual place, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's fine!
I don't mind at all... In fact, I'm happy to!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... I might get to see
a side of you that's closer to your true self.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right.
I forgot to tell you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas,
Trainer♪

And so, chatting away with North Flight...
the Christmas night deepened.
